titleEn: Decision No. 1212 on Issue the Mineral Exploration License to Allumina (Cambodia-Vietnam) Co. Ltd

articles.en: Allumina (Cambodia-Vietnam) Co., Ltd. shall carry out the exploration for bauxite ore on the land area specified above in accordance with its annual plan and work programme, ensuring compliance with the technical standards for mineral study and exploration.

This licence shall be valid for a period of 02 (two) years from the date of signature. Before the expiry of
30 days, the company shall apply afresh for a permit to continue its mineral study and exploration.
No. 45 Preah Norodom Boulevard, Doun Penh Khan, telephone (855) 23 211 141, fax: 855-23-428 263. Article 4: In the event of a breach of the terms of the agreement signed on 23 [illegible] 2020, this licence shall be revoked or a penalty shall be imposed in accordance with the Law on the Management and Exploitation of Mineral Resources.

= Director General of the General Department of Mineral Resources = Inspector General of the General Inspectorate = Director of the Accounting and Finance Department = Director of the Administration Department = Director of the Department of Industry, Mines and Energy of Mondulkiri Province, and Allumina (Cambodia-Vietnam) Co., Ltd., shall each be responsible for implementing this licence in accordance with their respective duties.
Article 6: This licence shall be effective from the date of this signature onwards.
